title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Use and Restriction of Articles)
(1) An admitted foreigner may use articles possessed at the time of admission while staying in the departure waiting room, except for articles falling under any subparagraph of Article 4 (1).
(2) The head, etc. shall store separately the articles referred to in the proviso to paragraph (1). Articles that are easily damaged or spoiled and difficult to store may be discarded with the consent of the admitted foreigner.
(3) Where an admitted foreigner possesses narcotics, firearms, or other articles whose possession is prohibited or restricted, the head, etc. shall notify the relevant investigative agency.
